### Қолданбалы экономика

Groups: 6 · Skills: 18

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specialized markets and institutional conditions in cities, housing, transport, education, healthcare, and agriculture create distinct economic mechanisms. This domain examines sector-specific choices and consequences without duplicating geographic, medical, educational, or agricultural competencies.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Экономикалық қағидалардың қала, тұрғын үй, көлік, білім, денсаулық және ауыл шаруашылығында қолданылуын зертте.

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Biological cycles, uncertain weather, land use, and international exchange shape agricultural markets.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ауыл шаруашылығында ерекше шығындар мен тәуекелдер неге бар екенін біл.

[agriculturalMarkets.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/agriculturalEconomics/agriculturalMarkets.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze farm-product prices in light of seasonality, storage opportunities, harvest variations, and international trade.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Азық-түлік бағасы маусым, өнім және саудаға қарай неге өзгеретінін зертте.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Фермерлер маусымдық белгісіздік пен ауа райы тәуекелдерін қалай басқаратынын түсін.

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/appliedEconomics/transportAndInfrastructure/index.ts)

### Тұтынушы мінез-құлқы

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consumers evaluate needs, quality, alternatives, and information under varying incomes and psychological constraints. This domain analyzes their choices rather than sellers' methods of promoting goods.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Адамдар нені сатып алуды қалай таңдайтынын және қандай ақпарат әсер ететінін зертте.

#### Таңдаудың мінез-құлық факторлары

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limited attention and rationality, time preferences, presentation formats, and defaults can alter economic choices even when the formal options are unchanged.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Нұсқаларды көрсету тәсілі шешімге қалай әсер ететінін біл.

##### Шектеулі ұтымдылық

[boundedRationality.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/boundedRationality.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how limits of time, knowledge, or computational ability lead decision-makers to use simplified rules.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Адамдар неге барлық нұсқаны салыстырмай, оңай жол іздейтінін түсін.

##### Таңдау сәулеті

[choiceArchitecture.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/choiceArchitecture.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how default options, presentation order, and the difficulty of opting out affect choices without changing the underlying alternatives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Әдепкі нұсқалар мен олардың орналасуы шешімді қалай бағыттайтынын байқа.

##### Фрейминг әсері

[framingEffect.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/framingEffect.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how equivalent information framed as gains or losses can change the assessment of a choice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Бір ақпарат табыс не шығын ретінде ұсынылса неге басқаша қабылданатынын зертте.

##### Қазіргі уақытқа бейімділік

[presentBias.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/behavioralFactorsInChoice/presentBias.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize systematic overvaluation of immediate benefits relative to delayed consequences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Дереу сыйақы алу неліктен болашақтағы жақсы нәтижеден басым түсуі мүмкін екенін түсін.

#### Тұтынушы ақпараты мен құқықтары

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sound consumer decisions depend not only on price but also on product information, contract terms, and possible protections.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ақпарат пен тұтынушы құқықтары сатып алу шешіміне қалай әсер ететінін біл.

##### Тұтынушы құқықтары мен міндеттері

[consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/consumerRightsAndResponsibilities.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret warranties, returns, and buyer and seller obligations in the applicable legal context.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Сатып алуға байланысты құқықтар мен міндеттерді таны.

##### Тұтынушылық ақпарат сапасы

[qualityOfConsumerInformation.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/qualityOfConsumerInformation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the origin, timeliness, and evidence supporting claims about goods and services, including review independence, rating representativeness, and sources' commercial interests.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Тауар туралы уәделер, рейтингтер мен пікірлер сенімді ме, тексер.

##### Сатып алудың толық құны

[totalCostOfPurchase.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/totalCostOfPurchase.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Estimate all substantial buyer-side costs, including delivery, operation, maintenance, and fees, when comparing options, even when these costs are disclosed. Seller-imposed optional extras belong to commercial-practices analysis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Тек көрсетілген бағаны емес, сатып алудың нақты толық шығынын салыстыр.

##### Бірлік бағасы

[unitPricing.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/consumerInformationAndRights/unitPricing.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convert offer prices into comparable units of mass, volume, or quantity while accounting for bundle contents, quality, and promotional conditions; a cheaper package need not have a cheaper unit price.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Бір бірліктің құнын есептеп, өнімдерді әділ салыстыр.

#### Қажеттіліктер мен талғамдар

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal goals and preferences explain why identical goods need not have identical value for different buyers.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Адамдардың тауарлар мен тәжірибені неге әртүрлі бағалайтынын зертте.

##### Шектеулі бюджеттегі тұтынушы таңдауы

[consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/consumerChoiceWithLimitedBudget.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare affordable bundles of goods and services according to preferences, income, and prices; apply the consumer budget constraint without treating it as the full model of all resource constraints.

##### Тұтынушы талғамдары

[consumerPreferences.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/consumerPreferences.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how an individual ranks alternative bundles of goods and services according to their own priorities.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Адамның тауарлардың әртүрлі жиынтығын қалай реттейтінін салыстыр.

##### Шекті пайдалылық

[marginalUtility.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/marginalUtility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the change in utility from consuming an additional unit with relevant conditions held constant; distinguish it from total utility.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Тауардың тағы бір данасы қандай қосымша құндылық беретінін зертте.

##### Қажеттіліктер мен тілектер

[needsAndWants.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/needsAndWants.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish what is necessary for a specified goal or living conditions from additional preferences without imposing a universal list of desires.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Нақты жағдайда қажеттілік пен тілек арасын ажырат.

##### Пайдалылық

[utility.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/consumerBehavior/needsAndPreferences/utility.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret utility as a model of an individual's preferences and valuation of consumption alternatives without assuming an objective universal unit of satisfaction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Пайдалылықты адамның нені бағалайтынын сипаттау тәсілі ретінде түсін.

### Даму, әл-ауқат және институттар

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/index.ts)

**User-friendly description (kk):** Қоғамдар арасында байлық, мүмкіндіктер және өмір сапасы неге әртүрлі екенін зерттеңіз.

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/index.ts)

**User-friendly description (kk):** Орташа табыс ресурстардың қалай бөлінетінін неге көрсетпейтінін зерттеңіз.

[giniCoefficient.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/giniCoefficient.ts)

[incomeDistribution.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/incomeDistribution.ts)

[intergenerationalEconomicMobility.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/intergenerationalEconomicMobility.ts)

[wealthDistribution.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/developmentWellbeingAndInstitutions/inequality/wealthDistribution.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze inequality in household net assets—property and financial claims less debt—separately from current income flows.

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/digitalEconomy/index.ts)

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/economicThinking/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Economic analysis examines how people and organizations choose among alternatives when resources are limited, respond to incentives, and coordinate decisions. It provides the conceptual foundation for other economic domains rather than a collection of everyday exercises.

[choiceUnderUncertainty.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/economicThinking/incentivesAndDecisions/choiceUnderUncertainty.ts)

[economicIncentives.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/economicThinking/incentivesAndDecisions/economicIncentives.ts)

Skills: 3

[strategicEquilibrium.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/economicThinking/strategicInteraction/strategicEquilibrium.ts)

[storeAssortment.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketingAndTrade/retailMerchandising/storeAssortment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate a product range in light of customer needs, stock limits, available space, and unsold-inventory risk.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Дүкен қандай тауарды ұсынатынын қалай таңдайтынын түсін.

[storeNavigation.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketingAndTrade/retailMerchandising/storeNavigation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how zones, signs, and shopper routes affect people's ability to find products.

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketingAndTrade/salesChannelsAndDistribution/index.ts)

**User-friendly description (kk):** Кәсіпорындардың өнімді клиентке жеткізу жолдарын салыстыр.

[distributionCosts.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketingAndTrade/salesChannelsAndDistribution/distributionCosts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how warehousing, transport, packaging, and logistical delays influence final price and product availability.

[wholesaleTrade.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketingAndTrade/salesChannelsAndDistribution/wholesaleTrade.ts)

### Нарықтар және бәсеке

Groups: 6 · Skills: 20

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Market prices and quantities arise from interactions between buyers and sellers under particular rules and competitive structures. This domain explains market mechanisms, not individual selling techniques.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Сатып алушылар, сатушылар мен бәсеке нарықтарды қалай қалыптастыратынын түсін.

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/competitiveMarketStructures/index.ts)

[marketPower.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/competitiveMarketStructures/marketPower.ts)

[typesOfMarketCompetition.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/competitiveMarketStructures/typesOfMarketCompetition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish perfect competition, monopolistic competition, oligopoly, and monopoly by their defining conditions.

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/demand/index.ts)

[changeInQuantityDemanded.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/demand/changeInQuantityDemanded.ts)

[shiftInDemand.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/demand/shiftInDemand.ts)

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/elasticity/index.ts)

[priceElasticityOfDemand.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/elasticity/priceElasticityOfDemand.ts)

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/marketsAndCompetition/marketOutcomes/index.ts)

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Households receive income, make payments, and decide how to save, borrow, and manage risks. This domain develops practical literacy rather than personalized investment advice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Бюджетті жоспарлауды, қарыз шарттарын түсінуді және күнделікті қаржылық шешім қабылдауды үйрен.

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/financialRisksAndProtection/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Financial security involves understanding acceptable risk, insurance options, and warning signs of deceptive offers.

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize implausible guaranteed returns, demands for urgent transfers, and opaque counterparties.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Күмәнді не алдамшы қаржы ұсыныстарының белгілерін таны.

[personalBudget.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/incomeAndBudgeting/personalBudget.ts)

[personalIncomeSources.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/personalFinance/incomeAndBudgeting/personalIncomeSources.ts)

[index.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/index.ts)

[marginalProductionCost.ts](../../../content/economics/data/skills/productionAndEntrepreneurship/productionCostsAndScale/marginalProductionCost.ts)
